notes.title: Sequel story "BLUE NIGHT LAUNDROMAT” will be released on Oct. 30!!!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970079/2e62d7d5243d5402c76ebb6af6852d1a9f73f13b.png

A retro-style short exploration ADV “BLUE NIGHT LAUNDROMAT” will be released on Oct. 30!!!!

This game is in Japanese but supports English. (Nearly automatic translation)🌟
＊ It is a sequel, but you can play it even if you have not played "PLEASE KNOCK" yet.

Please add us to your steam wishlist🌟

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3145540/BLUE_NIGHT_LAUNDROMAT/
